Build a Shipment module · 1 of 4
Principles · what hooks where

A shipment module is a downstream consumer,
just like OpalReturns.

The same pattern that produced OpalReturns produces a shipping integration. Zero PSP imports. Hook the events Payment Base already publishes. Mirror the architecture invariants. Ship faster than any PSP-coupled shipping module ever could.

Architecture invariants enforced
  • No PSP imports. Grep guard in pre-commit blocks any OxidEsales\Payments\Stripe reference.
  • No direct contract mutations. Dispatch events. Handlers mutate.
  • Tagged services for PSP-specific behaviour. Carrier-side code is PSP-independent.
  • Shared admin tab. Contribute a panel via oe.payment.admin_panel or its shipping-side equivalent.
